archetypes.name: call-site-audit
archetypes.rationale: Interface changes to design-publish.sh (new precondition, --skip-validate, exit 4) and design-postplan-emit.sh (dropped --force-validate) may have callers outside the 18 listed scope files that the plan silently leaves unpatched.
archetypes.prompt_body: Enumerate every invocation of design-publish.sh, design-postplan-emit.sh, invoke-plan-validator.sh, and redact-secrets.sh across the entire repo — not just the 18 scope files. For each call site, verify the plan explicitly covers it: updated flag lists, changed exit-code handling, or removed arguments. Pay special attention to hook scripts, CI YAML, Makefile targets, and doc snippets that might hard-code old flag names (--force-validate, --review-budget) or old precondition filenames (composed-plan.redacted.md). Confirm that every consumer of the design-publish.sh result env also has a plan update to parse the five new VALIDATE_* keys and react to exit code 4. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: cross-doc-drift
archetypes.rationale: review_budget, skipped-quick, and --force-validate are referenced across README, topology docs, configuration docs, and run-logs docs beyond the 18 plan-listed files; any missed reference leaves published documentation inconsistent with the new unconditional-validation behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Search the entire repo for every occurrence of review_budget, skipped-quick, --force-validate, FORCE_VALIDATE, and composed-plan.redacted.md — including README.md, docs/, skills/shared/, .claude/rules/, AGENTS.md, SECURITY.md, and topology.tsv. For each hit not covered by the plan's 18-file scope list, assess whether the reference describes behavior that the plan changes: if yes it is a plan gap; if it is a test fixture or intentional historical marker, confirm the plan explicitly addresses it. Also check whether removal of review_budget from write-run-params.sh and design-init-runparams.sh requires a schema_version bump or migration note anywhere in run-log or topology docs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retry-state-invariant
archetypes.rationale: The plan introduces a multi-path retry loop (Fix / Override / Cancel) around exit-4 with rm -f .design-publish-result.env as the sole stale-state guard; an ordering hole between result-env file creation, stdout-fallback parse, and the rm guard risks a retry consuming stale rc-4 fields as successful.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine every path through the Step 5c retry loop — Fix re-compose then re-capture, Override with --skip-validate, Cancel — and verify the plan's state-reset sequence (rm -f .design-publish-result.env, _publish_out / _publish_rc / result-env field replacement) is complete and correctly ordered on each path. Check whether the plan's stdout-fallback note (result-env write is non-fatal; caller falls back to stdout) is consistent with the rm guard: if the file is absent on a retry, does the parser fall back to _publish_out from the current attempt rather than a prior attempt's stdout capture. Also confirm that the anti-halt carve-out for rc 4 (no items 3-5, no final-summary, no Step 5d while rc is 4) is anchored to the latest _publish_rc assignment and cannot be prematurely cleared by a partial parse. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
